e.title: **新加坡 MAS 执法（Enforcement）页**（`mas.gov.sg/regulation/enforcement`）：⭐ 站点标题逐字为「**Enforcement**」——⭐ 页面自述逐字为「**Information on formal regulatory and enforcement actions taken by MAS for breaches of laws and regulations administered by MAS and related matters.**」；⭐ 它把**执法动作按类型计数公开在页面上**，逐字可见「**Reprimands 116**」「**Warnings 86**」「**Letters of Advice 305**」，并标注口径「**Based on figures from Enforcement Report 2023/2024 for the period between 1 July 2023 to 31 December 2024.**」——**统计期是 18 个月，不是自然年**；⭐ 页面另记机构史「**On 1 August 2016, MAS established a dedicated Enforcement Department**」。
e.summary: **新加坡金融管理局（MAS）的执法公开面**：本条补的是**「谁被处分」这一层**，并与第 385 轮的 [[mas-financial-institutions-directory]]（谁在册）配对。页面逐字自述为**「针对违反 MAS 所辖法律法规的正式监管与执法行动的信息」**；⭐ 它的独特之处是**把执法动作按类型计数直接放在页面上**：**Reprimands 116**、**Warnings 86**、**Letters of Advice 305**（另有 1 个标签在清洗文本中被截断），并给出统计口径**自 2023 年 7 月 1 日至 2024 年 12 月 31 日**（⚠️ **18 个月，不是自然年**）。页面另记 **2016 年 8 月 1 日**设立**专职执法部门**，并列出 **Enforcement Report** 与 **View enforcement actions** 两个入口。本次实测 **HTTP 200 / 274,737 字节**，清洗后可见正文 **11,899 字符**。
e.body:
**MAS（Monetary Authority of Singapore，新加坡金融管理局）的 Enforcement 页**（`mas.gov.sg/regulation/enforcement`）是**执法与处分的公开面**。⭐ 本条与**第 385 轮收录的 [[mas-financial-institutions-directory]]**（谁在册）**严格配对**：**名录回答「谁持牌、持哪一类牌」，本页回答「谁被处罚、处罚了多少次」**。
**页面自述逐字**：「**Information on formal regulatory and enforcement actions taken by MAS for breaches of laws and regulations administered by MAS and related matters.**」——即**这一页的定位是「正式监管与执法行动的信息」**，并且明确覆盖**违反 MAS 所辖法律法规**的情形。⭐ 页面另给出机构史：「**On 1 August 2016, MAS established a dedicated Enforcement Department within which MAS’ enforcement functions and capabilities are centralised.**」，并解释目的是「**enhancing consistency and expertise in the enforcement functions across the banking, insurance, capital markets and other sectors regulated by MAS.**」——**保险被明确列入集中执法的范围**。
⭐⭐ **本条最有分量的一层是「执法动作被计数并公开」**：页面逐字可见 **Reprimands 116**、**Warnings 86**、**Letters of Advice 305**（⚠️ **另有一个计数项的标签在清洗文本中被截断**，逐字只剩「**ion of Registration 35**」，本条**不猜测它是什么**，只如实记录截断）。⭐ 关键在于**统计口径**：页面逐字写「**Based on figures from Enforcement Report 2023/2024 for the period between 1 July 2023 to 31 December 2024.**」——⭐ **统计期是 2023 年 7 月 1 日到 2024 年 12 月 31 日，共 18 个月**。⚠️ **这意味着不能把这些数字当作「某一年」的量**；⭐ 这条与**第 385 轮**在英国 PRA 那条记下的「**季度编号用财年式写法（Q2 2026/27）**」是**同一类陷阱**：**监管披露的时间口径经常不是自然年**，**合并不同来源的数字前必须先对齐期间**。
**页面的入口结构**：链接文本逐字为 **Directories**、**Enforcement**、**Enforcement Report**、**View enforcement actions**——⭐ 即**名录（Directories）与执法（Enforcement）在站内是并列的两个入口**，**这份执法报告（Enforcement Report）是独立文件**，**而具体案件在「View enforcement actions」里查**。页面另出现「**Our Enforcement Monograph**」（⚠️ **该 PDF 体量在清洗文本中只到「442」处即截断**，本条不补全）。
**执法方针的三项目标**（页面逐字引出）：「**MAS’ enforcement approach has three aims: Early detection of misconduct and breaches of laws.**」（⚠️ **清洗文本只保留到第一项，后两项未取全**，本条**不补写**）；页面另有「**MAS Sets Up Dedicated Departments to Combat Money Laundering and Strengthen Enforcement**」一则，说明**反洗钱与执法职能被同时加强**。
**报告命名本身就是一条口径线索**：页面把数字归因给「**Enforcement Report 2023/2024**」，而**文件名的两个年份**与它声明的**18 个月期间（2023-07-01 至 2024-12-31）**正好对应——⭐ 即**这类报告是以「跨年度期间」而非自然年编制的**；⚠️ **该报告 PDF 未下载，报告内部是否另有年度拆分本次未验证**。
**与名录条目的配对细节**：站内把 **Directories** 与 **Enforcement** 并列为两个入口，⭐ 说明**MAS 自己就把「谁持牌」与「谁被罚」当成两件事分开摆**；对使用者来说，**尽调顺序应是「先名录、后执法」**（名录给身份，执法给记录）。
**与其他三条并读时的一条提醒**：本轮四条都公开处分信息，但⭐ **只有新加坡把「处分的数量」直接放在页面上**（澳洲给结果清单、爱尔兰给资金去向与警示、日本给索引与事例集）——⚠️ **计数方便但最容易误读**（期间不是自然年、总数不等于案件数，同一案件可能有多个处分动作），**引用这些数字时必须连口径一起引**。
**对 RIAA 学生的用法**：① 做**新加坡机构尽调**时，**先在 [[mas-financial-institutions-directory]] 查牌照类型，再在本页查有无处分记录**；② 做**执法数据研究**的，这页的**分类计数 + Enforcement Report** 是**可直接取数的公开面**，但要**先读清期间口径**；③ 与 [[apra-enforcement]]、[[central-bank-ireland-enforcement]]、[[japan-fsa-administrative-actions]] 并读，得到**四种把处分讲给公众听的做法**；④ 与本站的投诉／纠纷条目 [[hk-icb]]、[[fos-uk]] 对照：**「处分」与「投诉裁决」是两条不同的公开线**，⚠️ **不要把两者混为一条**。
**窗口状况（2026-10-01）**：`https://www.mas.gov.sg/regulation/enforcement` 实测 **HTTP 200 / 274,737 字节**，站点标题逐字「**Enforcement**」，清洗后可见正文 **11,899 字符**（enforcement 36 次、prohibition 3 次命中）。⚠️ **未核实项**：① **三项计数的完整标签与第四项**未取全（一项标签在清洗中截断）；② **Enforcement Report 与 Enforcement Monograph 两个 PDF 未下载**；③ **View enforcement actions 的检索接口是否可用、含哪些字段**未验证；④ **执法方针三项目标的后两项**未取全；⑤ **保险业在全部执法案件中的占比**未取。
e.verified_note: **窗口状况（2026-10-01）**：`https://www.mas.gov.sg/regulation/enforcement` 返回 **HTTP 200 / 274,737 字节**，站点标题逐字「**Enforcement**」；清洗后可见正文 **11,899 字符**（enforcement 36 次、prohibition 3 次）；同日实测，服务器 `date:` 头与本机 **2026-10-01** 一致。⚠️ **未核实**：① **执法计数共四项，其中一项的标签在清洗文本中被截断**（逐字只剩 **ion of Registration 35**）——本条**不猜测该标签**，只照抄可见部分；② **Enforcement Report 与 Enforcement Monograph 两个 PDF 未下载**（后者文本中只到「**Our Enforcement Monograph (442**」处即截断，**单位与完整大小未取**）；③ **View enforcement actions 的检索接口、字段与案件数**未验证；④ **执法方针三项目标页面只保留了第一项**（Early detection of misconduct and breaches of laws），**后两项未取，本条不补写**；⑤ **保险业案件占比**未取。⚠️ 页内英文引文逐字照抄（含 MAS’ 等所有格，撇号按 **U+2019** 转写）。
e.title_en: **MAS Enforcement page (Singapore)** at `mas.gov.sg/regulation/enforcement`: ⭐ the site title is, verbatim, **Enforcement** — ⭐ the page describes itself verbatim as **Information on formal regulatory and enforcement actions taken by MAS for breaches of laws and regulations administered by MAS and related matters.**; ⭐ it puts **enforcement actions on the page as counts**, verbatim **Reprimands 116**, **Warnings 86**, **Letters of Advice 305**, with the stated basis **Based on figures from Enforcement Report 2023/2024 for the period between 1 July 2023 to 31 December 2024.** — **an 18-month period, not a calendar year**; ⭐ it also records **On 1 August 2016, MAS established a dedicated Enforcement Department**.
e.title_hk: **新加坡 MAS 執法（Enforcement）頁**（`mas.gov.sg/regulation/enforcement`）：⭐ 站點標題逐字為「**Enforcement**」——⭐ 頁面自述逐字為「**Information on formal regulatory and enforcement actions taken by MAS for breaches of laws and regulations administered by MAS and related matters.**」；⭐ 佢將**執法動作按類型計數公開喺頁面**，逐字可見「**Reprimands 116**」「**Warnings 86**」「**Letters of Advice 305**」，並標註口徑「**Based on figures from Enforcement Report 2023/2024 for the period between 1 July 2023 to 31 December 2024.**」——**統計期係 18 個月，唔係自然年**；⭐ 頁面另記機構史「**On 1 August 2016, MAS established a dedicated Enforcement Department**」。
e.summary_en: **The enforcement disclosure surface of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS)**: this entry adds **who has been sanctioned**, pairing with [[mas-financial-institutions-directory]] from Round 385 (**who is licensed**). The page describes itself verbatim as **information on formal regulatory and enforcement actions taken by MAS for breaches of laws and regulations administered by MAS and related matters**; ⭐ its distinctive feature is that it **puts enforcement actions on the page as counts** — **Reprimands 116**, **Warnings 86**, **Letters of Advice 305** (plus one truncated label) — with the stated basis **1 July 2023 to 31 December 2024** (⚠️ **18 months, not a calendar year**). It also records that a **dedicated Enforcement Department** was established on **1 August 2016** and lists **Enforcement Report** and **View enforcement actions**. e.summary_hk: **新加坡金融管理局（MAS）嘅執法公開面**：本條補嘅係**「邊個被處分」呢一層**，並同第 385 輪嘅 [[mas-financial-institutions-directory]]（邊個在冊）配對。頁面逐字自述為**「針對違反 MAS 所轄法律法規嘅正式監管與執法行動嘅資訊」**；⭐ 佢嘅獨特之處係**將執法動作按類型計數直接放喺頁面**：**Reprimands 116**、**Warnings 86**、**Letters of Advice 305**（另有 1 個標籤喺清洗文本中被截斷），並給出統計口徑**自 2023 年 7 月 1 日至 2024 年 12 月 31 日**（⚠️ **18 個月，唔係自然年**）。頁面另記 **2016 年 8 月 1 日**設立**專職執法部門**，並列出 **Enforcement Report** 同 **View enforcement actions** 兩個入口。本次實測 **HTTP 200 / 274,737 字節**，清洗後可見正文 **11,899 字符**。
e.body_en:
**MAS’s Enforcement page** at `mas.gov.sg/regulation/enforcement` is **the public surface for enforcement and sanction in Singapore**. ⭐ It pairs strictly with **[[mas-financial-institutions-directory]] from Round 385**: **the directory says who holds which licence, this page says who has been sanctioned and how often**.
**The page describes itself, verbatim**: **Information on formal regulatory and enforcement actions taken by MAS for breaches of laws and regulations administered by MAS and related matters.** ⭐ It also records institutional history: **On 1 August 2016, MAS established a dedicated Enforcement Department within which MAS’ enforcement functions and capabilities are centralised.**, with the aim of **enhancing consistency and expertise in the enforcement functions across the banking, insurance, capital markets and other sectors regulated by MAS.** — **insurance is explicitly inside the scope of centralised enforcement**.
⭐⭐ **The most substantial layer is that enforcement actions are counted and published**: the page shows, verbatim, **Reprimands 116**, **Warnings 86** and **Letters of Advice 305** (⚠️ **one further label is truncated in the cleaned text**, surviving only as **ion of Registration 35**; this entry **does not guess what it is**). ⭐ What matters is the **stated basis**: **Based on figures from Enforcement Report 2023/2024 for the period between 1 July 2023 to 31 December 2024.** — ⭐ **the period is 1 July 2023 to 31 December 2024, eighteen months**. ⚠️ **These numbers therefore cannot be read as a single year.** ⭐ This is the **same class of trap recorded in Round 385** for the UK PRA, where quarterly identifiers use a fiscal-year form (**Q2 2026/27**): **regulatory disclosure periods are often not calendar years, so align the period before combining numbers from different sources**.
**Entry structure**: link texts are, verbatim, **Directories**, **Enforcement**, **Enforcement Report** and **View enforcement actions** — that is, **the directory and enforcement sit side by side**, **the enforcement report is a separate document**, and **individual cases live under View enforcement actions**. The page also mentions **Our Enforcement Monograph** (⚠️ **the cleaned text stops at 442, so its size and unit were not captured**, and this entry does not complete it).
**The stated three aims of the enforcement approach**: **MAS’ enforcement approach has three aims: Early detection of misconduct and breaches of laws.** (⚠️ **only the first aim survived cleaning; the other two were not retrieved and are not invented here**). A separate item, **MAS Sets Up Dedicated Departments to Combat Money Laundering and Strengthen Enforcement**, shows **anti-money-laundering and enforcement capacity being strengthened together**.
**How an RIAA student can use it.** (1) For **Singapore due diligence**, check the licence type in [[mas-financial-institutions-directory]] first, then look for sanctions here. (2) For **enforcement data work**, the class counts plus the **Enforcement Report** are **a directly usable public surface**, provided the **period basis is read first**. (3) Read it with [[apra-enforcement]], [[central-bank-ireland-enforcement]] and [[japan-fsa-administrative-actions]] for **four ways of explaining sanction to the public**. (4) Compare with the complaint and dispute entries [[hk-icb]] and [[fos-uk]]: **sanctions and complaint adjudication are two different public lines**, ⚠️ **not one**.
**Window status (2026-10-01)**: `https://www.mas.gov.sg/regulation/enforcement` returned **HTTP 200 / 274,737 bytes**, site title verbatim **Enforcement**, with **11,899 visible characters** after cleaning (36 hits of enforcement, 3 of prohibition). ⚠️ **Not verified**: (1) the **complete labels of all four counts** (one is truncated); (2) the **Enforcement Report and Enforcement Monograph PDFs**; (3) the **fields and case counts of the View enforcement actions search**; (4) the **second and third aims** of the enforcement approach; (5) **the insurance share of all enforcement cases**.
e.body_hk:
**MAS（新加坡金融管理局）嘅 Enforcement 頁**（`mas.gov.sg/regulation/enforcement`）係**執法同處分嘅公開面**。⭐ 本條同**第 385 輪收錄嘅 [[mas-financial-institutions-directory]]**（邊個在冊）**嚴格配對**。
**頁面自述逐字**：「**Information on formal regulatory and enforcement actions taken by MAS for breaches of laws and regulations administered by MAS and related matters.**」；⭐ 另記機構史「**On 1 August 2016, MAS established a dedicated Enforcement Department within which MAS’ enforcement functions and capabilities are centralised.**」，目的係「**enhancing consistency and expertise in the enforcement functions across the banking, insurance, capital markets and other sectors regulated by MAS.**」——**保險被明確列入集中執法範圍**。
⭐⭐ **本條最有分量嘅一層係「執法動作被計數並公開」**：頁面逐字可見 **Reprimands 116**、**Warnings 86**、**Letters of Advice 305**（⚠️ **另有一項標籤喺清洗文本中被截斷**，逐字只剩「**ion of Registration 35**」，本條**唔猜佢係咩**）。⭐ 關鍵係**統計口徑**：頁面逐字寫「**Based on figures from Enforcement Report 2023/2024 for the period between 1 July 2023 to 31 December 2024.**」——⭐ **統計期係 2023 年 7 月 1 日到 2024 年 12 月 31 日，共 18 個月**。⚠️ **唔可以當呢啲數字係「某一年」嘅量**。
**入口結構**：連結文本逐字為 **Directories**、**Enforcement**、**Enforcement Report**、**View enforcement actions**——⭐ 即**名錄同執法喺站內係並列嘅兩個入口**。頁面另出現「**Our Enforcement Monograph**」（⚠️ **清洗文本只到「442」處即截斷**）。
**執法方針三項目標**：「**MAS’ enforcement approach has three aims: Early detection of misconduct and breaches of laws.**」（⚠️ **只保留到第一項，後兩項未取全，本條唔補寫**）。
**對 RIAA 學生嘅用法**：① 做**新加坡機構盡調**時，先在 [[mas-financial-institutions-directory]] 查牌照，再喺本頁查處分；② 做**執法數據研究**嘅，分類計數 + Enforcement Report 係可取數嘅公開面，但要**先讀清期間口徑**；③ 同 [[apra-enforcement]]、[[central-bank-ireland-enforcement]]、[[japan-fsa-administrative-actions]] 並讀；④ 同投訴／糾紛條目 [[hk-icb]]、[[fos-uk]] 對照：**「處分」同「投訴裁決」係兩條唔同嘅公開線**。
**窗口狀況（2026-10-01）**：`https://www.mas.gov.sg/regulation/enforcement` 實測 **HTTP 200 / 274,737 字節**，站點標題逐字「**Enforcement**」，清洗後可見正文 **11,899 字符**。⚠️ **未核實項**：① **四項計數其中一項標籤被截斷**；② **兩個 PDF 未下載**；③ **View enforcement actions 檢索接口未驗證**；④ **方針後兩項目標未取全**；⑤ **保險業佔比未取**。
